title.zh: 为向拉古纳省纳格卡尔兰镇前镇长胡安·贝拉斯科的遗孀或其所在辖区指挥官拨付1500美元本地货币而制定的法案
title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING ONE THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED DOLLARS, IN LOCAL CURRENCY, TO BE PAID TO THE WIDOW OF JUAN VELASCO, LATE PRESIDENT OF NAGCARLAN, LAGUNA, OR TO THE COMMANDING OFFICER OF THE DISTRICT FOR HER BENEFIT.
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING ONE THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED DOLLARS, IN LOCAL CURRENCY, TO BE PAID TO THE WIDOW OF JUAN VELASCO, LATE PRESIDENT OF NAGCARLAN, LAGUNA, OR TO THE COMMANDING OFFICER OF THE DISTRICT FOR HER BENEFIT.
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp 1500 đô la tiền tệ địa phương cho góa phụ của Juan Velasco, cựu Chủ tịch Thị trấn Nagcarlan, Tỉnh Laguna hoặc cho Sĩ quan chỉ huy Khu vực để chi trả cho bà
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรเงิน๑๕๐๐ดอลลาร์สกุลเงินท้องถิ่นเพื่อจ่ายให้กับภรรยาหม้ายของฮวนเวลาสโกประธานเมืองนางคาร์ลันจังหวัดลากูนาหรือผู้บัญชาการเขตเพื่อประโยชน์ของเธอ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan 1500 dolar mata uang lokal untuk dibayarkan kepada janda Juan Velasco, mantan Presiden Kota Nagcarlan, Provinsi Laguna atau kepada Perwira Komandan Distrik untuk kepentingannya
title.ms: Akta mengperuntukkan 1500 dolar mata wang tempatan untuk dibayar kepada balu Juan Velasco, bekas Presiden Bandar Nagcarlan, Wilayah Laguna atau kepada Pegawai Memerintah Daerah bagi kepentingannya

text.en:
Whereas Juan Velasco, president of Nagcarlan, Laguna, was murdered while in the discharge of
his official duties because of the efficient administration of his office and his loyalty to the United States, and
his untimely death leaves his wife and two children in needy circumstances:
The sum of one thousand five hundred dollars, in local currency, is hereby appropriated, out of any money in
the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be paid, in the discretion of the Civil Governor, either to
the widow of Juan Velasco or to the commanding officer of the district, to be held and expended by him for
her benefit.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 3, 1902.
